core_connection.text: HOSHINOYA Kyoto is a hotel in Arashiyama where Mia and Victor stayed in March 2025 and booked again for April 2026. Mia arranges transfers, activities and dinner with Kenji in Guest Relations.

evidence.quote: Thank you so much for a wonderful stay from March 28 to 30.
it is lovely to hear from you again
Dear Kenji, thank you so much!
Thank you so much for the detailed information.
hi we just arrived at the lounge
Thank you so much for a wonderful stay
Thank you so much for finding it!
Following up on two things for our stay

facts.text: This is a hotel, and Mia's contact there is Kenji in Guest Relations, whom she writes to by first name.
Mia travels with Victor, and they book for 2 adults.
First stay: March 28 to 30, 2025. Mia called it a wonderful stay.

evidence.quote: a wonderful stay from March 28 to 30

facts.text: Guests reach the hotel by boat from the Arashiyama reception lounge. On March 28, 2025 they arrived around 3:00 PM and took the 3:15 PM boat.

evidence.quote: would like to take the 3:15 PM boat
hi we just arrived at the lounge

facts.text: Both of them were booked for the 7:00 AM Zen meditation on March 29, 2025.

evidence.quote: reserve the 7:00 AM session on March 29

facts.text: They chose the 8:00 PM kaiseki dinner seating on March 28, 2025.

evidence.quote: We would prefer the 8:00 PM kaiseki seating

facts.text: Food preference: Victor does not eat raw shellfish, so Mia asked the kitchen to swap that course for him.

evidence.quote: Victor prefers not to have raw shellfish

facts.text: They travelled with two large suitcases and asked whether to send them ahead by takkyubin from their hotel in Tokyo.

evidence.quote: We will have two large suitcases.

facts.text: Mia left a gray wool scarf in the room after the 2025 stay. The hotel found it, Mia paid for EMS shipping, and she asked for the tracking number.

evidence.quote: I left a gray wool scarf in our room
I've completed the payment for the EMS shipping.

facts.text: Second stay: April 6 to 8, 2026, a repeat visit. Mia asked for a taxi from the Hachijo exit of Kyoto Station at 2:30 PM on April 6.

evidence.quote: picking us up at the Hachijo exit at 2:30 PM

facts.text: For 2026, Mia booked the 3:00 PM tea ceremony on April 7 and asked for the 6:30 PM evening boat on April 6.

evidence.quote: Please book the 3:00 PM tea ceremony on April 7

facts.text: Writing style: Mia sends numbered lists of requests and is warm and grateful. Quick replies while travelling can be one lowercase line, such as confirming she finished the pre-arrival form.
